notes: attempt-1 was exploratory (variable summaries, no RESULT lines). The final run is the first and only estimating run, and the script was not changed after comparing it with the claims. Data: replication_data.dta. Per-capita variables are wrights/pcmean and mills/pcmean; their means (3.76, 18.922) match Table 1. Sample: the 298 districts with non-missing Domesday mills. Controls: main geo = latitude, longitude, dist_rug_mean, dist_elevation_mean; agricultural = suitmean, 1(wheat_tmean<=5), dist_grass_mean; climatic = precip_mean_dist, temp_mean_dist; other = pcmean, min_harbor, DIST_London, min_dist_to_roman_rds, min_dist_2nav_rivers, area. River suitability = riv_rug26count (river length at ruggedness 2-6). Instrument = riv_rug26count x 1(wheat_tmean<=5), with both components as controls in every IV. Estimated with fixest OLS/2SLS and SEs clustered by historical county (GAZ_CNTY, 35 clusters). The first-stage F is the squared cluster-robust t of the excluded instrument (equivalent to the Kleibergen-Paap Wald F with one instrument); it reproduces 19.90/16.96/16.17. iid and heteroskedasticity-robust F values, printed as diagnostics, do not match.
